meaning.en: Occurring or extending throughout a county.

sentences.en: Then I looked up the Pinkville newspaper but it was merged into a countywide paper four years ago.

sentences.en: Its position at the center of Wiltshire has made it the headquarters of many countywide organizations, including the constabulary.

sentences.en: In psychiatric hospitals, the countywide average stay has plummeted from 22 days five years ago to 13 days now.

sentences.en: Health officials said they hae also notified emergency rooms countywide of the outbreak.
